welcome1.message: Welcome to the WARS TCG in DragnCards 2.0! You can build a custom deck under 'Builder' or load a pre-built from 'Menu -> Load -> Load Prebuilt Deck'. To draw cards or move them between piles - simply drag and drop from that pile or area to your target. At End of turn, click the menu on your lost pile and choose 'Move to -> Player1Reserve -> Bottom'. Visit https://warstcg.org for more information, and online rules.
